source_inspection.hf_features: tokenizer(prompt, truncation=True, max_length=max_length); map_token_positions maps all answer tokens to the retained model offsets
source_inspection.hf_features_chunked: chunks the context, not the answer; short context falls through to hf_features even for a long answer
source_inspection.consequence: Output token_count/schema do not prove full model coverage. Unmapped long-answer positions cannot be treated as fully inferred risks. Exact unmapped-position count was not measured; no invented count is reported.

frozen_model_policy: No change to frozen feature extraction/window512/chunking or feature substitution was introduced to conceal this limitation. Cached P5 dev parity remains zero, but does not certify native long-input feature coverage.
context_2M_distinction: The 2M-context request indexes the full generated document into 2022 chunks and evaluates 3 retrieved chunks under the frozen policy, with a short answer. It is NOT evidence that a 2M-character answer or every fact in a 2M document receives a full HF forward pass.
acceptance_effect: Recorded latency is timing of the existing product path only. Even a fast completed long-answer request must not be upgraded to valid full-text throughput or full long-input functional acceptance.
